meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让同一安装接听多个号码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给现有直线添加额外接听号码
copy.tagline_en: Answer calls on multiple numbers from a single installation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Dial channel and need to add another number

howto.what: 给已装好 Dial 渠道的 NanoClaw 再加一个电话号码，让同一个安装能在多个号码上收发短信、接听 AI 语音通话。新号码是一条独立的分组会话线，回复从收到消息的那个号码发出，已有线路不受影响。
howto.when: 当你已经装好 Dial 渠道，想给 agent 再添一个号码（例如个人线加客服线）时触发。前置条件是 Dial 已安装，否则先运行 /add-dial。

say.text: 给我的 Dial 渠道再加一个电话号码
say.note: 会先列出账号上已有的号码供你选

say.text: 把这个新号码接到客服那个 agent group
say.note: 会为这条线建立会话组并绑定该 agent

say.text: 这条线设成 public，谁都能发消息进来
say.note: strict 只放行已知用户，public 任何人可发

howto.what_en: Adds another number to an already-installed Dial channel, so one NanoClaw install serves SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Each number is its own threaded line, replies leave from the receiving number, and existing lines stay unchanged.
howto.when_en: Use when Dial is already installed and you want an extra number for the agent, such as a personal line plus a support line. Requires the Dial channel to be installed first (see /add-dial).

say_en.text: Add another phone number to my Dial channel
say_en.note: Lists the account's existing numbers first

say_en.text: Wire this new number to my support agent group
say_en.note: Creates the line and links it to that agent

say_en.text: Set this line to public so anyone can text it
say_en.note: strict allows known users only; public allows anyone
